summary: Frontend-only static UI verification for the Priority Debater redesign across /commerce, /commerce/scanning, /commerce/verdict, /commerce/agent, /commerce/monitor at desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px). All redesign requirements verified via Playwright DOM/computed-style assertions. No backend exists (per request).

issues: Recharts logs two non-blocking console warnings ('width(-1) and height(-1)...') on initial mount before the ResponsiveContainer measures its parent. Cosmetic only — chart renders correctly with the blue (#2d6bff) line afterwards. Consider giving the parent an explicit min-height or aspect prop to silence the warning.

action_items: Optional: silence the two Recharts width/height(-1) initial-mount warnings on /commerce/monitor by setting an explicit min-width/height or aspect on the ResponsiveContainer parent.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx: the Box (.pd-box) component still has data-testid='red-box-highlight' even though it now renders the BLUE accent box. Consider renaming to 'accent-box-highlight' or 'blue-box-highlight' to avoid misleading future readers/tests.

Blocks.jsx Section: the 'N' marker is created via aria-hidden span — good. All sections share identical markup, so the marker is consistent across all 5 verdict / 4 agent / 4 monitor sections (verified 5 markers on verdict).

Verdict.jsx queryPills array is declared but never rendered into the page — dead code (the AI chat card is rendered, but the pills const is unused on the new design). Either render them under 'data-testid=query-pills' or remove the const.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All redesign requirements (section rhythm, blue-as-primary, red-only-for-danger, exactly ONE yellow CTA per page, N markers, data-testids) are verified working at 1440px and 390px. Only two non-blocking console warnings from Recharts on Monitor. No functional issues. The 'red-box-highlight' data-testid in Nav.jsx is now a misnomer (the box is blue) and Verdict.jsx has an unused queryPills const — both are minor code-hygiene items, not bugs.
